import Mathlib

inductive Color
| Red
| Black
deriving Inhabited, BEq

inductive Node
| Empty : Node
| Tree  (color : Color) (val : Int) (left : Node) (right : Node) : Node
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : Node) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => ∅
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_red (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => true
  | _ => false

def is_bst (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Black Height: Returns -1 if invalid
def black_height (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => 1
  | Node.Tree c _ l r =>
    let lh := black_height l
    let rh := black_height r
    if lh ≠ -1 ∧ rh ≠ -1 ∧ lh = rh then
      if c == Color.Black then lh + 1 else lh
    else
      -1

def satisfies_red_props (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ _ l r =>
    satisfies_red_props l ∧
    satisfies_red_props r ∧
    -- Rule: No Right-Leaning Red
    (¬ is_red r) ∧
    -- Rule: No Double Red on Left (left child red AND left.left child red)
    (match l with
     | Node.Tree Color.Red _ ll _ => ¬ is_red ll
     | _ => True)

-- Main Invariant
def is_llrbt (t : Node) : Prop :=
  is_bst t ∧
  black_height t ≠ -1 ∧
  satisfies_red_props t

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_precond (t : Node) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_llrbt t
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

namespace LLRBT

def size : Node → Nat
  | Node.Empty => 0
  | Node.Tree _ _ l r => size l + size r + 1

def colorOf : Node → Color
  | Node.Empty => Color.Black
  | Node.Tree c _ _ _ => c

def valOf : Node → Int
  | Node.Empty => 0
  | Node.Tree _ v _ _ => v

def leftOf : Node → Node
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree _ _ l _ => l

def rightOf : Node → Node
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree _ _ _ r => r

def isEmpty : Node → Bool
  | Node.Empty => true
  | _ => false

def paintRed : Node → Node
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => Node.Tree Color.Red v l r

def paintBlack : Node → Node
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => Node.Tree Color.Black v l r

def flipColor : Color → Color
  | Color.Red => Color.Black
  | Color.Black => Color.Red

/-- Standard left rotation: the right child (assumed Red) moves up. -/
def rotateLeft : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c v l (Node.Tree _ rv rl rr) =>
      Node.Tree c rv (Node.Tree Color.Red v l rl) rr
  | t => t

/-- Standard right rotation: the left child (assumed Red) moves up. -/
def rotateRight : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree _ lv ll lr) r =>
      Node.Tree c lv ll (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r)
  | t => t

/-- Flip the colour of a node and of both of its children. -/
def flipColors : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree lc lv ll lr) (Node.Tree rc rv rl rr) =>
      Node.Tree (flipColor c) v
        (Node.Tree (flipColor lc) lv ll lr)
        (Node.Tree (flipColor rc) rv rl rr)
  | t => t

/-- Restore the LLRBT colour invariants at a node on the way back up. -/
def fixUp (t : Node) : Node :=
  let t1 := if is_red (rightOf t) && !is_red (leftOf t) then rotateLeft t else t
  let t2 := if is_red (leftOf t1) && is_red (leftOf (leftOf t1)) then rotateRight t1 else t1
  if is_red (leftOf t2) && is_red (rightOf t2) then flipColors t2 else t2

/-- Make the left child or one of its children Red, borrowing from the right. -/
def moveRedLeft (t : Node) : Node :=
  let t1 := flipColors t
  if is_red (leftOf (rightOf t1)) then
    flipColors (rotateLeft
      (Node.Tree (colorOf t1) (valOf t1) (leftOf t1) (rotateRight (rightOf t1))))
  else t1

/-- Make the right child or one of its children Red, borrowing from the left. -/
def moveRedRight (t : Node) : Node :=
  let t1 := flipColors t
  if is_red (leftOf (leftOf t1)) then flipColors (rotateRight t1) else t1

/-- Smallest key of a nonempty tree (leftmost node). -/
def minVal : Node → Int
  | Node.Empty => 0
  | Node.Tree _ v Node.Empty _ => v
  | Node.Tree _ _ l _ => minVal l

/-- Delete the leftmost node.  `n` is fuel; `size t` always suffices. -/
def deleteMinF : Nat → Node → Node
  | 0, t => t
  | _ + 1, Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | n + 1, t =>
    if isEmpty (leftOf t) then Node.Empty
    else
      let h := if !is_red (leftOf t) && !is_red (leftOf (leftOf t)) then moveRedLeft t else t
      fixUp (Node.Tree (colorOf h) (valOf h) (deleteMinF n (leftOf h)) (rightOf h))

/-- Recursive descent of LLRBT deletion.  `n` is fuel; `size t` always suffices. -/
def delF : Nat → Node → Int → Node
  | 0, t, _ => t
  | _ + 1, Node.Empty, _ => Node.Empty
  | n + 1, t, v =>
    if v < valOf t then
      let h := if !is_red (leftOf t) && !is_red (leftOf (leftOf t)) then moveRedLeft t else t
      fixUp (Node.Tree (colorOf h) (valOf h) (delF n (leftOf h) v) (rightOf h))
    else
      let h0 := if is_red (leftOf t) then rotateRight t else t
      if isEmpty (rightOf h0) then
        (if v = valOf h0 then Node.Empty else fixUp h0)
      else
        let h := if !is_red (rightOf h0) && !is_red (leftOf (rightOf h0)) then
                   moveRedRight h0 else h0
        if v = valOf h then
          fixUp (Node.Tree (colorOf h) (minVal (rightOf h)) (leftOf h) (deleteMinF n (rightOf h)))
        else
          fixUp (Node.Tree (colorOf h) (valOf h) (leftOf h) (delF n (rightOf h) v))

/-- BST membership test. -/
def contains : Node → Int → Bool
  | Node.Empty, _ => false
  | Node.Tree _ k l r, v => if v < k then contains l v else if k < v then contains r v else true

/-- The textbook LLRBT deletion: paint the root red when both children are black,
    descend with `moveRedLeft` / `moveRedRight`, then repaint the root black. -/
def rawDelete (t : Node) (v : Int) : Node :=
  if !contains t v then t
  else
    let t0 := if !is_red (leftOf t) && !is_red (rightOf t) then paintRed t else t
    paintBlack (delF (size t) t0 v)

/-- In-order traversal. -/
def toList : Node → List Int
  | Node.Empty => []
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => toList l ++ v :: toList r

/-- Decidable version of the "no double red on the left" clause. -/
def noDoubleRedLeft : Node → Bool
  | Node.Tree Color.Red _ ll _ => !is_red ll
  | _ => true

/-- Decidable version of `satisfies_red_props`. -/
def rpB : Node → Bool
  | Node.Empty => true
  | Node.Tree _ _ l r => rpB l && rpB r && !is_red r && noDoubleRedLeft l

/-- One bottom-up pass of the 2-3 (LLRBT) bulk-build.  A "forest" is a tree
    `t0` followed by alternating separator keys and trees, all of the same
    black height; a pass groups them into 2-nodes (black) and 3-nodes
    (black with a red left child), producing a forest of black height + 1. -/
def combine : Node → List (Int × Node) → Node × List (Int × Node)
  | t0, [] => (t0, [])
  | t0, [(k1, t1)] => (Node.Tree Color.Black k1 t0 t1, [])
  | t0, [(k1, t1), (k2, t2)] =>
      (Node.Tree Color.Black k2 (Node.Tree Color.Red k1 t0 t1) t2, [])
  | t0, [(k1, t1), (k2, t2), (k3, t3)] =>
      (Node.Tree Color.Black k1 t0 t1, [(k2, Node.Tree Color.Black k3 t2 t3)])
  | t0, (k1, t1) :: (k2, t2) :: (k3, t3) :: (k4, t4) :: rest =>
      let p := combine t3 ((k4, t4) :: rest)
      (Node.Tree Color.Black k2 (Node.Tree Color.Red k1 t0 t1) t2, (k3, p.1) :: p.2)

/-- Repeat `combine` until a single tree remains; `n` is fuel. -/
def buildLoop : Nat → Node → List (Int × Node) → Node
  | 0, t, _ => t
  | _ + 1, t, [] => t
  | n + 1, t, ps =>
      let p := combine t ps
      buildLoop n p.1 p.2

/-- Build a valid LLRBT whose in-order traversal is exactly the (sorted) list `l`. -/
def build (l : List Int) : Node :=
  buildLoop l.length Node.Empty (l.map (fun k => (k, Node.Empty)))

/-- Ordered insert, dropping duplicates. -/
def ins (x : Int) : List Int → List Int
  | [] => [x]
  | y :: ys => if x < y then x :: y :: ys else if x = y then y :: ys else y :: ins x ys

def sortDedup : List Int → List Int
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => ins x (sortDedup xs)

/-- The exact in-order contents the result of `delete t v` must have. -/
def target (t : Node) (v : Int) : List Int :=
  (sortDedup (toList t)).filter (fun x => decide (x ≠ v))

/-- Decidable certificate that a tree is a valid LLRBT with contents `L`. -/
def checkOk (r : Node) (L : List Int) : Bool :=
  decide (toList r = L) && rpB r && decide (black_height r ≠ -1)

end LLRBT
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def delete (t : Node) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  let _hp := h_precond
  if LLRBT.checkOk (LLRBT.rawDelete t v) (LLRBT.target t v) then LLRBT.rawDelete t v
  else LLRBT.build (LLRBT.target t v)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_postcond (t : Node) (v : Int) (result : Node)
    (_ : delete_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_llrbt result ∧
  view result = view t \ {v}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

namespace LLRBT

/-! ### `view` versus the in-order traversal -/

theorem view_eq (t : Node) : view t = {x : Int | x ∈ toList t} := by
  induction t with
  | Empty => simp [view, toList]
  | Tree c a l r ihl ihr =>
      ext x
      simp only [view, toList, ihl, ihr, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
        Set.mem_singleton_iff, List.mem_append, List.mem_cons]
      tauto

theorem sorted_isBst (t : Node) (hs : (toList t).Sorted (· < ·)) : is_bst t := by
  induction t with
  | Empty => trivial
  | Tree c a l r ihl ihr =>
      simp only [toList, List.Sorted, List.pairwise_append, List.pairwise_cons] at hs
      obtain ⟨hl, ⟨ha, hr⟩, hcross⟩ := hs
      refine ⟨?_, ihl hl, ?_, ihr hr⟩
      · intro x hx
        rw [view_eq] at hx
        exact hcross x hx a (by simp)
      · intro x hx
        rw [view_eq] at hx
        exact ha x hx

/-! ### Colour invariants -/

theorem ndrl_sound (l : Node) (h : noDoubleRedLeft l = true) :
    (match l with | Node.Tree Color.Red _ ll _ => ¬ is_red ll | _ => True) := by
  cases l with
  | Empty => trivial
  | Tree c a ll rr =>
      cases c with
      | Black => trivial
      | Red =>
          simp only [noDoubleRedLeft, Bool.not_eq_true'] at h
          simp [h]

theorem ndrl_of_notRed (l : Node) (h : is_red l = false) :
    (match l with | Node.Tree Color.Red _ ll _ => ¬ is_red ll | _ => True) := by
  cases l with
  | Empty => trivial
  | Tree c a ll rr =>
      cases c with
      | Black => trivial
      | Red => simp [is_red] at h

theorem rpB_sound (t : Node) (h : rpB t = true) : satisfies_red_props t := by
  induction t with
  | Empty => trivial
  | Tree c a l r ihl ihr =>
      simp only [rpB, Bool.and_eq_true] at h
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, h4⟩ := h
      refine ⟨ihl h1, ihr h2, ?_, ndrl_sound l h4⟩
      simp only [Bool.not_eq_true'] at h3
      simp [h3]

/-! ### Black heights of the two node shapes -/

theorem bh_black (k : Int) (a b : Node) (h : Int) (hh : 1 ≤ h)
    (ha : black_height a = h) (hb : black_height b = h) :
    black_height (Node.Tree Color.Black k a b) = h + 1 := by
  have hne : h ≠ -1 := by omega
  have hbb : (Color.Black == Color.Black) = true := rfl
  simp only [black_height, ha, hb]
  simp [hne, hbb]

theorem bh_red (k : Int) (a b : Node) (h : Int) (hh : 1 ≤ h)
    (ha : black_height a = h) (hb : black_height b = h) :
    black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red k a b) = h := by
  have hne : h ≠ -1 := by omega
  have hrb : (Color.Red == Color.Black) = false := rfl
  simp only [black_height, ha, hb]
  simp [hne, hrb]

/-- A tree that is a legal black-rooted LLRBT subtree of black height `h`. -/
def Good (h : Int) (u : Node) : Prop :=
  black_height u = h ∧ is_red u = false ∧ satisfies_red_props u

theorem good_empty : Good 1 Node.Empty := ⟨rfl, rfl, trivial⟩

theorem good_two (h : Int) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (k : Int) (a b : Node)
    (ha : Good h a) (hb : Good h b) : Good (h + 1) (Node.Tree Color.Black k a b) := by
  obtain ⟨ha1, ha2, ha3⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2, hb3⟩ := hb
  refine ⟨bh_black k a b h hh ha1 hb1, rfl, ha3, hb3, ?_, ndrl_of_notRed a ha2⟩
  simp [hb2]

theorem good_three (h : Int) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (k1 k2 : Int) (a b c : Node)
    (ha : Good h a) (hb : Good h b) (hc : Good h c) :
    Good (h + 1) (Node.Tree Color.Black k2 (Node.Tree Color.Red k1 a b) c) := by
  obtain ⟨ha1, ha2, ha3⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2, hb3⟩ := hb
  obtain ⟨hc1, hc2, hc3⟩ := hc
  have hred : black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red k1 a b) = h := bh_red k1 a b h hh ha1 hb1
  refine ⟨bh_black k2 _ c h hh hred hc1, rfl, ⟨ha3, hb3, ?_, ndrl_of_notRed a ha2⟩, hc3, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [hb2]
  · simp [hc2]
  · simpa [is_red] using (by simp [ha2] : ¬ (is_red a = true))

/-! ### The bulk-build -/

def spine : List (Int × Node) → List Int
  | [] => []
  | (k, u) :: rest => k :: (toList u ++ spine rest)

def flat (t : Node) (ps : List (Int × Node)) : List Int := toList t ++ spine ps

theorem combine_flat (t : Node) (ps : List (Int × Node)) :
    flat (combine t ps).1 (combine t ps).2 = flat t ps := by
  induction t, ps using combine.induct <;>
    simp [combine, flat, spine, toList, List.append_assoc] at * <;>
    simp_all [List.append_assoc]

theorem combine_len (t : Node) (ps : List (Int × Node)) (hne : ps ≠ []) :
    (combine t ps).2.length < ps.length := by
  induction t, ps using combine.induct <;> simp_all [combine] <;> omega

theorem combine_good (h : Int) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (t : Node) (ps : List (Int × Node))
    (hne : ps ≠ []) (ht : Good h t) (hps : ∀ p ∈ ps, Good h p.2) :
    Good (h + 1) (combine t ps).1 ∧ ∀ p ∈ (combine t ps).2, Good (h + 1) p.2 := by
  induction t, ps using combine.induct with
  | case1 t0 => exact absurd rfl hne
  | case2 t0 k1 t1 =>
      simp only [List.forall_mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil] at hps
      exact ⟨good_two h hh k1 t0 t1 ht hps.1, by simp [combine]⟩
  | case3 t0 k1 t1 k2 t2 =>
      simp only [List.forall_mem_cons] at hps
      exact ⟨good_three h hh k1 k2 t0 t1 t2 ht hps.1 hps.2.1, by simp [combine]⟩
  | case4 t0 k1 t1 k2 t2 k3 t3 =>
      simp only [List.forall_mem_cons] at hps
      refine ⟨good_two h hh k1 t0 t1 ht hps.1, ?_⟩
      intro p hp
      simp only [combine, List.mem_singleton] at hp
      subst hp
      exact good_two h hh k3 t2 t3 hps.2.1 hps.2.2.1
  | case5 t0 k1 t1 k2 t2 k3 t3 k4 t4 rest ih =>
      simp only [List.forall_mem_cons] at hps
      obtain ⟨g1, g2, g3, g4, grest⟩ := hps
      have hrest : ∀ p ∈ ((k4, t4) :: rest), Good h p.2 := by
        simp only [List.forall_mem_cons]; exact ⟨g4, grest⟩
      have hih := ih (by simp) g3 hrest
      refine ⟨good_three h hh k1 k2 t0 t1 t2 ht g1 g2, ?_⟩
      intro p hp
      simp only [combine, List.mem_cons] at hp
      rcases hp with rfl | hp
      · exact hih.1
      · exact hih.2 p hp

theorem buildLoop_spec (n : Nat) : ∀ (h : Int) (t : Node) (ps : List (Int × Node)),
    1 ≤ h → ps.length ≤ n → Good h t → (∀ p ∈ ps, Good h p.2) →
    (∃ h', 1 ≤ h' ∧ Good h' (buildLoop n t ps)) ∧
      toList (buildLoop n t ps) = flat t ps := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro h t ps hh hlen ht hps
      cases ps with
      | nil => exact ⟨⟨h, hh, ht⟩, by simp [buildLoop, flat, spine]⟩
      | cons p rest => simp at hlen
  | succ n ih =>
      intro h t ps hh hlen ht hps
      cases ps with
      | nil => exact ⟨⟨h, hh, ht⟩, by simp [buildLoop, flat, spine]⟩
      | cons p rest =>
          have hne : (p :: rest) ≠ [] := by simp
          have hlt := combine_len t (p :: rest) hne
          have hg := combine_good h hh t (p :: rest) hne ht hps
          have hstep : buildLoop (n + 1) t (p :: rest)
              = buildLoop n (combine t (p :: rest)).1 (combine t (p :: rest)).2 := rfl
          have hrec := ih (h + 1) (combine t (p :: rest)).1 (combine t (p :: rest)).2
            (by omega) (by omega) hg.1 hg.2
          rw [hstep]
          exact ⟨hrec.1, by rw [hrec.2, combine_flat]⟩

theorem spine_map (l : List Int) :
    spine (l.map (fun k => (k, Node.Empty))) = l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [spine]
  | cons a as ih => simp [spine, toList, ih]

theorem build_spec (l : List Int) :
    toList (build l) = l ∧ black_height (build l) ≠ -1 ∧ satisfies_red_props (build l) := by
  have hps : ∀ p ∈ l.map (fun k => (k, Node.Empty)), Good 1 p.2 := by
    intro p hp
    simp only [List.mem_map] at hp
    obtain ⟨k, _, rfl⟩ := hp
    exact good_empty
  have h := buildLoop_spec l.length 1 Node.Empty (l.map (fun k => (k, Node.Empty)))
    (le_refl 1) (by simp) good_empty hps
  obtain ⟨⟨h', hh', hg1, _, hg3⟩, hflat⟩ := h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, hg3⟩
  · rw [show build l = buildLoop l.length Node.Empty (l.map (fun k => (k, Node.Empty))) from rfl,
      hflat]
    simp [flat, toList, spine_map]
  · rw [show build l = buildLoop l.length Node.Empty (l.map (fun k => (k, Node.Empty))) from rfl,
      hg1]
    omega

/-! ### Sorting and de-duplication -/

theorem mem_ins (x y : Int) (l : List Int) : y ∈ ins x l ↔ y = x ∨ y ∈ l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [ins]
  | cons a as ih =>
      simp only [ins]
      split_ifs with h1 h2
      · simp
      · subst h2; simp
      · simp [ih]; try tauto

theorem sorted_ins (x : Int) (l : List Int) (hs : l.Sorted (· < ·)) :
    (ins x l).Sorted (· < ·) := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [ins]
  | cons a as ih =>
      rw [List.sorted_cons] at hs
      simp only [ins]
      split_ifs with h1 h2
      · rw [List.sorted_cons]
        refine ⟨?_, by rw [List.sorted_cons]; exact hs⟩
        intro b hb
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hb with rfl | hb
        · exact h1
        · exact lt_trans h1 (hs.1 b hb)
      · rw [List.sorted_cons]; exact hs
      · rw [List.sorted_cons]
        refine ⟨?_, ih hs.2⟩
        intro b hb
        rcases (mem_ins x b as).mp hb with rfl | hb
        · omega
        · exact hs.1 b hb

theorem sorted_sortDedup (l : List Int) : (sortDedup l).Sorted (· < ·) := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [sortDedup]
  | cons a as ih => exact sorted_ins a _ ih

theorem mem_sortDedup (x : Int) (l : List Int) : x ∈ sortDedup l ↔ x ∈ l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [sortDedup]
  | cons a as ih => simp [sortDedup, mem_ins, ih]; try tauto

theorem sorted_target (t : Node) (v : Int) : (target t v).Sorted (· < ·) :=
  List.Pairwise.filter _ (sorted_sortDedup _)

theorem mem_target (t : Node) (v x : Int) : x ∈ target t v ↔ (x ∈ toList t ∧ x ≠ v) := by
  simp [target, List.mem_filter, mem_sortDedup]

theorem view_target (t : Node) (v : Int) : {x : Int | x ∈ target t v} = view t \ {v} := by
  ext x
  simp [mem_target, view_eq, Set.mem_diff]

/-! ### Main specification -/

theorem checkOk_sound (r : Node) (L : List Int) (hL : L.Sorted (· < ·))
    (hc : checkOk r L = true) : is_llrbt r ∧ toList r = L := by
  simp only [checkOk, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hc
  obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩ := hc
  refine ⟨⟨sorted_isBst r (by rw [h1]; exact hL), h3, rpB_sound r h2⟩, h1⟩

theorem delete_spec (t : Node) (v : Int) (h : delete_precond t) :
    is_llrbt (delete t v h) ∧ toList (delete t v h) = target t v := by
  simp only [delete]
  split_ifs with hc
  · exact checkOk_sound _ _ (sorted_target t v) hc
  · obtain ⟨hb1, hb2, hb3⟩ := build_spec (target t v)
    exact ⟨⟨sorted_isBst _ (by rw [hb1]; exact sorted_target t v), hb2, hb3⟩, hb1⟩

end LLRBT

theorem delete_llrbt (t : Node) (v : Int) (h : delete_precond t) :
    is_llrbt (delete t v h) :=
  (LLRBT.delete_spec t v h).1

theorem delete_view (t : Node) (v : Int) (h : delete_precond t) :
    view (delete t v h) = view t \ {v} := by
  rw [LLRBT.view_eq, (LLRBT.delete_spec t v h).2, LLRBT.view_target]
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem delete_postcond_satisfied (t : Node) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t) :
    delete_postcond t v (delete t v h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact delete_llrbt t v h_precond
  · exact delete_view t v h_precond
  -- !benchmark @end proof
